note: Hover tooltips for section titles. 'concepts' paraphrase the book's definitions (page cited); each section's 'does' describes what the prototype screen does and is not book text.

trait.name: Trait
trait.text: An enduring part of your character's nature. Every character has at least one trait: their species.

attribute.name: Attributes
attribute.text: Six ratings (Control, Daring, Fitness, Insight, Presence, Reason) for your physical and mental capabilities and the way you approach problems. For humanoids they range from 7 to 12; 8 is average.

discipline.name: Disciplines
discipline.text: Six areas of expertise (Command, Conn, Engineering, Security, Science, Medicine), matching a starship's departments. Each is rated from 0 to 5.

focus.name: Focus
focus.text: A short description of a narrower skill, topic, or activity. Focuses improve your odds at tasks they apply to and can be used with any discipline.

value.name: Value
value.text: A short statement of a core belief or conviction. Values define who your character is and can give them an extra push to succeed in difficult situations.

assignment.name: Assignment
assignment.text: Your role aboard ship. The book lists the most common senior staff roles and says other roles are possible.

rank.name: Rank
rank.text: Your place in the chain of command. Starfleet officers run from Ensign to Captain; enlisted personnel have their own ranks.

speciesScreen.title: Species
speciesScreen.what: Book Step One. Your species is your character's first trait and raises three attributes by 1.
speciesScreen.does: Choose a species card and a gender, then complete any trait details and attribute choices below.

speciesGender.title: Gender
speciesGender.what: Decides which portraits you can pick on Finishing Touches.
speciesGender.does: Choose Male, Female, or Other. Other can use any portrait for the species. Gender has no effect on attributes, disciplines, values, focuses, traits, or any rule, and it is separate from pronouns.

environmentScreen.title: Environment
environmentScreen.what: Book Step Two. Where and how your character was raised: either a Setting or a Condition. It grants one value, +1 to one attribute, and +1 to one discipline.
environmentScreen.does: Pick the Setting or Condition tab and a card, then choose the value, attribute, and discipline below.

earlyOutlookScreen.title: Early Outlook
earlyOutlookScreen.what: Book Step Three. Your childhood, formative experiences, and key influences.
earlyOutlookScreen.does: Choose an outlook card, then its attribute path, one discipline, and one focus.

educationScreen.title: Education
educationScreen.what: Book Step Four. Your training before your career. Each option grants one value, three attribute points, discipline increases, and three focuses.
educationScreen.does: Choose an education type card and one of its options, then make the choices in the numbered sections.

careerScreen.title: Career
careerScreen.what: Book Step Five sets how long your career has run and grants one value. Assignment and rank come from Book Step Seven (pp.130-132).
careerScreen.does: Choose a career length and its value, then your assignment and rank.

careerHistoryScreen.title: Career History
careerHistoryScreen.what: Book Step Six. Defining events in your career. Each raises one attribute and one discipline by 1 and grants one focus.
careerHistoryScreen.does: Choose two different events, then complete each one's attribute, discipline, and focus.

finishingTouchesScreen.title: Finishing Touches
finishingTouchesScreen.what: Book Step Seven. One final value, and +1 to two attributes and two disciplines, kept within the book's limits.
finishingTouchesScreen.does: Work through each card: final value, attributes, disciplines, name and pronouns, portrait, and optional notes.

reviewScreen.title: Character Complete
reviewScreen.does: Check each section, fix anything under Needs Attention, then Confirm Character. Export JSON (Dev) downloads the character as a .json file.

reviewStatus.title: Status
reviewStatus.what: Checks your character against the finished-character requirements: every step complete, a name and pronouns, attributes total 56, disciplines total 16, four values, six focuses, and no duplicate values or focuses.
reviewStatus.does: Lists each problem with a link to the screen that fixes it. When nothing is listed, Confirm Character becomes available.

reviewIdentity.title: Identity
reviewIdentity.what: Who your character is: name, gender, pronouns, species, species trait, and portrait. Gender is a presentation detail only.
reviewIdentity.does: Summary only. Change these on Species and Finishing Touches.

reviewOrigin.title: Origin & Early Life
reviewOrigin.what: Where your character was raised and the outlook they grew up with.
reviewOrigin.does: Summary only. Change these on Environment and Early Outlook.

reviewAttributes.does: Your final scores. The book's finished character has an attribute total of 56, no attribute above 12, and only one at 12. Change them on Finishing Touches.

reviewDisciplines.does: Your final scores. The book's finished character has a discipline total of 16, no discipline above 5, and only one at 5. Change them on Finishing Touches.

reviewEducation.title: Education
reviewEducation.what: The education option your character trained in and its category.
reviewEducation.does: Summary only. Change it on Education.

reviewCareer.title: Career
reviewCareer.what: Your career length, assignment, department, and rank.
reviewCareer.does: Summary only. Change these on Career. Posting will be chosen with your ship, which is not built yet.

reviewEvents.title: Career Events
reviewEvents.what: The defining events of your career and what each one gave you.
reviewEvents.does: Summary only. Change them on Career History.

reviewValues.does: Every value and the screen it came from. The book's finished character has four values.

reviewFocuses.does: Every focus and the screen it came from. The book's finished character has six focuses.

reviewTraits.does: Your traits and their descriptions. Change them on Species.

reviewEquipment.title: Equipment
reviewEquipment.what: Standard-issue gear, assigned automatically from your department, plus the background notes you wrote on Finishing Touches.
reviewEquipment.does: Summary only. Equipment changes with your assignment and department on Career. Notes are free text the rules never read.

speciesTraits.does: Your species becomes your first trait automatically. Mixed Heritage and New Species ask for extra details here.

speciesAttributes.does: Shows the three attributes your species raises by +1. Some species let you choose which three.

environmentValue.does: Choose one value that reflects the place or circumstances you were raised in.

environmentAttribute.does: Raise one attribute by +1. The attributes offered depend on the Setting or Condition you chose.

outlookAttribute.does: Your early outlook offers different paths, each with its own attribute bonuses. Choose one path.

outlookDiscipline.does: Raise one discipline by +1, from those your early outlook offers.

outlookFocus.does: Choose one focus: a book example for your outlook, one from the Focus Matrix, or your own.

educationOptions.title: Education Options
educationOptions.what: Your training before your career began. Each option grants a value, attribute points, disciplines, and focuses.
educationOptions.does: Pick one option from the education type chosen above. The numbered sections below then apply its benefits.

educationDetails.title: Education Details
educationDetails.what: The book's description and rules for the option you selected.
educationDetails.does: Reference only; nothing to choose here.

educationAttributes.does: Spend the attribute points your education gives. The instruction shows how many points and any limits.

educationDisciplines.does: Choose the disciplines your education improves. Some options also allow an optional discipline swap.

educationFocuses.does: Choose the focuses your education gives: book examples, the Focus Matrix, or your own.

educationValue.does: Choose one value you gained from your education.

careerValue.does: Choose one value that fits how long your career has run.

careerAssignment.does: Choose your role aboard ship. It sets your department and minimum officer rank. Some roles are closed to Novice or enlisted characters.

assignmentDetails.title: Assignment Details
assignmentDetails.what: The department, minimum rank, and book description for your assignment.
assignmentDetails.does: Reference only, except when the book names no department; then choose one here.

careerRank.does: Choose your rank. What you can pick depends on your education (officer, enlisted, or civilian), your assignment's minimum rank, and your career length.

eventAttribute.does: Raise one attribute by +1. Most events set it; some let you choose.

eventDiscipline.does: Raise one discipline by +1. Most events set it; some let you choose.

eventFocus.does: Choose one focus reflecting this event: a book example, the Focus Matrix, or your own.

eventDetails.title: Event Details
eventDetails.what: The book's effects for the selected event, plus questions to help you imagine it.
eventDetails.does: Reference only; nothing to choose here.

finalValue.does: Choose your last value. It might reflect your career events or who your character has become.

valueDetails.title: Value Details
valueDetails.what: The book's text for this step and every value you have chosen so far.
valueDetails.does: Reference only; nothing to choose here.

attributeIncreases.does: Add +1 to several different attributes. Each row shows the current score and the final score.

attributeDetails.title: Attribute Details
attributeDetails.what: The book's text for this step and the attribute limits.
attributeDetails.does: If a score goes over the limit, choose where the extra points go here. The total must come out exactly right.

disciplineIncreases.does: Add +1 to several different disciplines. Each row shows the current score and the final score.

disciplineDetails.title: Discipline Details
disciplineDetails.what: The book's text for this step and the discipline limits.
disciplineDetails.does: If a score goes over the limit, choose where the extra points go here. The total must come out exactly right.

characterName.title: Name
characterName.what: Your character's name. Type one or roll a random male, female, or mixed name.
characterName.does: Required. Becomes the exported file's name. The same name is edited on the Name & Pronouns card.

nameAndPronouns.title: Name & Pronouns
nameAndPronouns.does: Both are required. The name becomes the exported file's name. Pick a pronoun set or type your own.

identityDetails.title: Identity Details
identityDetails.does: Reference only; nothing to choose here.

portraitOptions.title: Portrait
portraitOptions.what: How your character looks on the character sheet.
portraitOptions.does: Choose a preset portrait. The presets shown match the species and gender chosen on Species. Portraits are presentation only and have no game-rule effect.

portraitDetails.title: Portrait Details
portraitDetails.what: Controls for browsing the portrait presets.
portraitDetails.does: Step through the presets one at a time.

backgroundNotes.title: Background Notes
backgroundNotes.what: Optional free text about your character's history, personality, and relationships.
backgroundNotes.does: Saved and exported with your character. The rules never read these notes.

notesDetails.title: Notes Details
notesDetails.does: Reference only; nothing to choose here.
